title: Unify autofill, password-reveal, and clear actions across form inputs
creator: Asha Patel
description: Current input controls across the platform show inconsistent behavior for browser autofill, password reveal toggles, and the clear (x) affordance. These inconsistencies cause small but frequent UX regressions: misplaced icons, missing focus styles after autofill, unexpected mobile keyboard changes, and inconsistent screen‑reader announcements. This ticket aims to define a single, accessible, token-driven pattern for: 1) handling browser/autocomplete/autofill UI states; 2) the password reveal control (placement, label, and keyboard behavior); and 3) the clear action for text inputs and search fields. The final spec should be implementable in React component primitives and documented in the design system with examples for desktop, iOS/Android webviews, and RTL locales.
acceptance_criteria: A single spec document exists describing visual, interaction, and accessibility requirements for autofill, password reveal, and clear actions
Figma component library updated with tokens and variants for: default, autofill, autofill-focused, with-clear, with-password-reveal, dense and touch density
Engineering acceptance: prototype implementation (ENG-4122) matches spec across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and mobile webviews
Screen reader behavior documented and validated with VoiceOver and NVDA users: announce state changes for reveal and clear actions
No regression in input focus ring, placeholder behavior, or text selection after autofill in documented browsers
RTL mirror checked and documented for icon placement and hit target alignment
Design tokens documented for icon spacing, hit target, control z-order, and autofill color overlay
tasks: Audit current input component variants across product surfaces (console, onboarding, SDK docs)
Collect examples of autofill quirks per browser and mobile webview
Draft visual spec and microcopy for password reveal and clear actions
Create Figma components + tokens and publish to library
Partner with ENG to implement prototype and run cross-browser QA
Write design-system docs and accessibility checklist
Add unit/e2e tests for focus behavior and keyboard interactions
decisions: Place password reveal inside input trailing zone using visually-hidden label 'Show password' / 'Hide password' for screen readers
Clear action should be a secondary affordance that only appears when input has value and should not replace native autofill icons
Autofill visual overlay will use a dedicated token (color.autofill.surface) and not rely on browser yellow; provide fallback styles for browsers that ignore custom styling
All interactive affordances must meet 44px minimum tap target; visual density variants will adjust spacing via tokens rather than new components
notes: Browsers expose autofill in inconsistent ways; where possible, use semantics and focus hooks instead of relying on UA rendering
iOS webviews often strip custom CSS for autofill; include guidance for mobile native wrappers
Cross-team review needed with Security regarding clipboard behavior for clear action (avoid exposing sensitive data)
